verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a desktop remote-access client, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The CLI and REST API items are about installation, sessions, and account data, which are unrelated to telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
